text: The Fed's divided quarter-point cut coupled with hawkish guidance and renewed Treasury purchases exposes constrained policy choice, inverting conventional easing into reserve containment as internal authority splits widen and the committee compresses options to preserve financial continuity amid data gaps and leadership transition.

meta.note: Easing functions as stabilization plumbing, not directional stimulus.

text: Coca-Cola appointing COO Henrique Braun as CEO in 2026 reinforces structural continuity rather than disruption, retrieving long-tenured internal leadership to align with shifting global demand patterns while preserving board-level coherence through Quincey's transition to executive chairman.

meta.note: Succession occurs as alignment rather than correction; the field stabilizes through internal retrieval instead of authority break.
